previous_versions.body: So if you are talking about the fact that [the cheatsheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Forgot_Password_Cheat_Sheet.html) refers to using email as an out of band channel, I'm pretty sure that when it says that email is not allowed as an out of band authenticator, it is talking as a primary authentication factor and not as a recovery mechanism. Clearly the use of email as a recover mechanism for a password is pretty universal.
